title: 第1章 蜣螂生灵名茅不易第2章 无意杀人却背此锅
content_zh:
“憋不住了，憋不住了！”
一男子，身着青云宗外门弟子服，死死捂住屁股，两腿如风，冲入“东司”（厕所的雅称）之中。
他先是利落的脱下裤子，随后捂着肚子，一屁股蹲了下去。
“扑哧——”“扑哧——”
随着几声羞耻的声音响起，坑中变得一片褐黄。
“哎呀，昨天就不该嘴馋，灵果吃多了，竟闹肚子了。”
哎呦声过后，他踉跄的站起身，跺了跺发麻的双腿，提上裤子，快步离开。
丝毫没有注意到坑中那道泛着白光的小东西。
那是一只蜣螂。
蜣螂，蜣螂，春生秋亡，尚无名姓。
只是一只顺着本能进食的凡虫，觅食之时，无意间坠入了此地。
初觉宝地温暖潮湿，美食遍地，是个养老的好地方。
奈何一股灵气，溅在了他坚固的甲壳之上。
一股莫名的燥热瞬间席卷全身，一股名为灵气的东西，悄然在他的体内浮现，顺着经络蔓延全身。
下一刻，一道光亮劈开他意识之中的黑暗，如同盘古开天，混沌初生。
他先是诞生了灵智，后又产生了思想。
眼中黯淡的世界变为了彩色，无数的信息涌入了他的脑海之中。
蜣螂生灵，天道不允。
上方的天空顿时乌云密布，电闪雷鸣。
一道道如银龙般的雷电劈下，青云宗的护宗大阵被其震得涟漪不断。

大阵的波动自然瞒不住青云宗的宗主。
洞天福地中一俊秀少年突然睁开双眼，神识如汪洋大海一般瞬间淹没全宗。
凡神识覆盖之处，皆无所遁形。
片刻之后，少年眉头微皱。
“怪事？！既逆天之物诞生，又无弟子晋级，为何会引来如此雷劫？”
那始作俑者此时正死死趴在地上，因为恐惧，浑身止不住的颤抖。
这雷劫的气息是冲他而来，若无大阵庇护，此刻他怕是已经烟消云散。
怪哉，怪哉，世间万物皆可有灵，竟偏不容一蜣螂！
这蜣螂诞生于茅坑的污秽之中，幸得大阵庇护，苟得一条性命。
生存不易。
便叫他茅不易吧！
雷劫过后，一连数日他都躲在这污秽之处。
他想要再度寻得那日的灵气入体，却迟迟未能实现。
他不禁思考了起来。
问题出在了哪里？
content_en:
"I can't hold it in anymore, I can't hold it in anymore!"
A man, wearing the uniform of an outer disciple of the Qingyun Sect, tightly covering his buttocks, his legs like the wind, rushed into the "Dongsi" (the elegant name of the toilet).
He took off his pants neatly first, then held his stomach and squatted down.
"Puchchi——" "Puchchi——"
As a few shameful sounds were heard, the pit turned brown.
"Oh, I shouldn't have been greedy yesterday. I ate too much spiritual fruit and got upset."
After the ouch, he stood up staggeringly, stamped his numb legs, pulled up his pants, and left quickly.
He didn't even notice the little thing glowing with white light in the pit.
That's a dung beetle.
Dung beetles, dung beetles, live in spring and die in autumn, and they have no name yet.
It was just a mortal insect that followed its instinct to eat. When it was looking for food, it accidentally fell into this place.
Chujue Treasure Land is warm and humid, with delicious food everywhere. It is a good place to retire.
However, a burst of spiritual energy splashed onto his solid carapace.
An inexplicable heat swept through his body instantly, and something called spiritual energy quietly emerged in his body and spread throughout his body along his meridians.
The next moment, a ray of light split open the darkness in his consciousness, just like Pangu opened the sky and chaos was born.
He gave birth first to the intellect, and then to thought.
The dim world in his eyes turned into color, and countless information poured into his mind.
God does not allow dung beetles to live.
The sky above suddenly became covered with dark clouds, and there was lightning and thunder.
Thunder and lightning struck down like silver dragons one after another, causing the Qingyun Sect's sect-protecting formation to ripple.
Naturally, the fluctuations of the formation cannot be hidden from the master of Qingyun Sect.
A handsome young man in the Cave Heaven Paradise suddenly opened his eyes, and his spiritual consciousness flooded the entire sect instantly like a vast ocean.
Wherever the divine consciousness covers it, there is nothing to hide.
After a moment, the young man frowned slightly.
"A strange thing?! Since something against the heavens was born and no disciples advanced, why did it cause such a thunder disaster?"
The instigator was currently lying on the ground, trembling uncontrollably out of fear.
The aura of thunder and calamity was coming towards him. Without the protection of the large formation, he would have disappeared into thin air at this moment.
Strange, strange, everything in the world can have spirits, but not even a dung beetle!
This dung beetle was born in the filth of the latrine. Fortunately, it was protected by the formation and managed to survive.
Survival is not easy.
Just call him Mao Buyi!
After the thunderstorm, he hid in this filthy place for several days.
He wanted to find the spiritual energy from that day to enter his body again, but he was unable to do so.
He couldn't help but think.
What's the problem?
